title: Ender Woman
description: Add a female model to the Enderman.
body:
Give the Enderman a stunning new appearance with this female-inspired model and texture pack!

This resource pack replaces the default Enderman with a custom female-style version while preserving its iconic tall and mysterious presence. Featuring a redesigned 3D model, updated textures, and an elegant End-themed look, it blends naturally into Minecraft's vanilla aesthetic.

Requirements

This resource pack requires Custom Entity Models (CEM) support. You can use a compatible version of OptiFine, or install the Entity Texture Features (ETF) and Entity Model Features (EMF) mods to ensure the custom model and textures work correctly.
